title: Bank Visit
setting: Bank counter or customer service desk in Costa Rica
userGoal: Ask for account, transfer, and document help in a formal, clear way.
starterPrompts: Que documentos necesito para abrir una cuenta?
culturalNotes: Bank staff often appreciate formal phrasing and one question at a time.
Numbers, fees, and document names can come fast, so slow listening matters.
It helps to confirm the next step before leaving the counter.
likelyMisunderstandings: The learner may mix up account type, transfer amount, and fee details.
The clerk may use formal phrasing or document vocabulary quickly.
The learner may not ask for the next step after hearing the requirements.

variants.title: Account opening
variants.setup: You are at the service desk asking what you need to open an account.
variants.localReplyStyle: The clerk gives a formal answer with document names and one next step.
variants.pressureNote: Listen for ID, proof of address, and any form you need to sign.
variants.starterPrompt: Que documentos necesito para abrir una cuenta?

variants.title: Transfer issue
variants.setup: You need help with a transfer that did not go through as expected.
variants.localReplyStyle: The clerk asks for the amount, destination, and the date of the transfer.
variants.pressureNote: The answer may include a fee or a system check.
variants.starterPrompt: No me aparece una transferencia de ayer.

variants.title: Card or statement help
variants.setup: You need a statement or help with a card problem before a trip.
variants.localReplyStyle: The staff member keeps the reply formal and practical.
variants.pressureNote: Expect one detail about printing, signing, or waiting in line.
variants.starterPrompt: Necesito un estado de cuenta y una carta.

turns.title: State the request
turns.learnerGoal: Ask for the service you need with a formal opening.
turns.prompt: Buenos dias. En que le puedo ayudar?
turns.repairCue: If the learner is vague, narrow it to the account, transfer, or document issue.

branchOptions.label: Open an account
branchOptions.prompt: Necesito abrir una cuenta, por favor.

branchOptions.label: Ask about a transfer
branchOptions.prompt: Necesito ayuda con una transferencia de ayer.

turns.title: Clarify the requirement
turns.learnerGoal: Ask what documents or information are required.
turns.prompt: Necesito su documento, una constancia de domicilio y una firma aqui.
turns.repairCue: If the learner misses one document, repeat just that item.

branchOptions.label: Repeat the documents
branchOptions.prompt: Entonces necesito documento y constancia de domicilio, verdad?

branchOptions.label: Ask about fees
branchOptions.prompt: Hay alguna comision por este tramite?

turns.title: Confirm the next step
turns.learnerGoal: Leave with one clear next action or fee confirmation.
turns.prompt: Le reviso los datos y luego le llamamos para finalizar.
turns.repairCue: If the learner only says yes, ask them to repeat the next step in their own words.

branchOptions.label: Confirm next step
branchOptions.prompt: Perfecto. Entonces espero la llamada para finalizar.

branchOptions.label: Ask one more question
branchOptions.prompt: Y la comision queda igual o cambia?

followUpDrills.title: Ask formally for help
followUpDrills.goal: Practice a polite bank opening line.
followUpDrills.prompt: Buenos dias, necesito ayuda con una transferencia.

followUpDrills.title: Compare documents and next steps
followUpDrills.goal: Practice asking for required papers and the next action.
followUpDrills.prompt: Que documentos necesito? / Cual es el siguiente paso?
steps: Repeat the answer in your own words.

followUpDrills.title: Shadow the formal line
followUpDrills.goal: Repeat a formal clerk reply at natural speed.
followUpDrills.prompt: Necesito su documento, una constancia de domicilio y una firma aqui.

followUpDrills.title: Dictate the document list
followUpDrills.goal: Write the required papers you hear in order.
followUpDrills.prompt: Necesito su documento, una constancia de domicilio y una firma aqui.

followUpDrills.title: Split forms and fees
followUpDrills.goal: Let one partner handle documents and the other handle fees or timing.
followUpDrills.prompt: Partner A asks about documents. Partner B asks about the fee or next step.
steps: Partner A asks for the requirements.

coupleSupport.sharedGoal: One partner keeps track of documents while the other keeps track of fees and timing.
partnerRoles: Partner A asks about documents and signatures
Partner B asks about fees and the next step
handoffPrompts: Ahora tu pareja pregunta por los documentos.
Tu turno: pregunta por la comision o el siguiente paso.
coupleSupport.keepBothInvolvedTip: Bank language is formal, so keep the turns short and give each partner one specific job.

listeningCues.focus: formal service language and document lists
listeningCues.previewLine: Necesito su documento, una constancia de domicilio y una firma aqui.
